title: promo_3d_template - 6 s scattered in depth -> one flat grid -> title

polarity.from: work scattered in every direction and depth
polarity.statement: The product turns files scattered through space into one calm, ordered grid.

camera3d.why_3d: Space IS the message: depth = disorder (cards at every distance and angle), flatness = order (one plane, one angle). A 2D fake could show scatter, but not the moment depth collapses into a single plane.
camera3d.key_light: gold rim from upper left + ambient
camera3d.dof: focus on the headline while it is read, pulled to the grid plane for the snap

from.meaning: files at every distance: too much, nowhere in particular
we move into the mess; its depth shows how much there is
most of it is out of focus: you can only read one thing at a time

to.meaning: depth collapses into one plane: order arrives at once
the ordered system is lit and alive
the system steps back so the name can lead

neutral.meaning: attention moves to what should be read now
a ground to stand on: makes the space legible

easing.transform: cubic_in_out (camera: slow in, slow out, no overshoot)

stagger.rule: the 30 cards snap simultaneously: order arrives at once (used once)

beats.dominant: 30 cards burst out of the depth, tumbling
headline card arrives frontal, in focus
cards tumble as the camera pushes in
near cards sweep past the lens
headline departs expo-in, focus pulls to the grid plane
every card snaps flat into one grid
gold key light sweeps across the grid

events.visual: camera dollies 3400 -> 1800 units along the axis, through the scattered cards

move3d.meaning: moving into the mess: its depth shows how much there is; settles frontal as order arrives

events.visual: TOO MANY FILES? card arrives frontal (expo-out), in the focus plane
all 30 cards snap flat into a 6x5 grid (expo-out, peak on this frame) + 0.45 flash
events.anticipation: riser + headline exits expo-in + focus pull to the grid plane

move3d.meaning: depth collapses into one plane: chaos becomes order at once

events.visual: gold key light sweeps left to right across the grid (2.9-3.6 s)

move3d.meaning: the ordered system is lit and alive

events.visual: grid recedes 0 -> -900 units (expo-in) and darkens, flash ramp

move3d.meaning: the system steps back so the name can lead

events.visual: flash 0.85, flat title zooms 1.18 -> 1, centre-out letters

quiet.reason: end card rest: flat, frontal, still; let the brand read
